title: 1st Annual Meet of Regional Centres of PvPI & MvPI on 27th - 28th February 2026
bodyHtml:
📢 Announcing the 1st Annual Meet of Regional Centres of PvPI & MvPI!

🗓️ Dates: 27th – 28th February 2026

📍 Venue: Kalam Convention Centre, Andhra Pradesh MedTech Zone (AMTZ), Visakhapatnam

Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission (IPC) is organizing this meet in collaboration with the Kalam Institute of Health Technology (KIHT), it will bring together Regional Centres for PvPI & MvPI from across the country to strengthen India’s Pharmacovigilance and Materiovigilance Systems.

📌 Registration Deadline: 31st January 2026
How to Register: Scan the QR code on the brochure to register!
